title: TencentCloud/Octop: a self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent assistant
friendlyTitle: Octop is a self-hosted assistant for teams
summary: Octop is a self-hosted assistant platform for multiple users and agents, with a web dashboard, desktop packaging, connectors, skills and deployment options. The repository reached about 2,900 stars and version 1.0.0 this week while leading today’s AI-related Python trends.
friendlySummary: Octop lets several users run AI agents in a system they can host themselves. It includes a dashboard, connectors and desktop options.
whyItMatters: Teams can study or deploy it as an owned assistant workspace rather than placing every workflow in a hosted chat product. Its multi-user permissions, connector surface and upgrade path should be tested carefully before production use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help a team keep more control over its assistant setup. Test permissions, backups and connectors before using it with important data.
